response.description:
Azure HorizonDB now supports database auditing with the pgAudit
extension. You can capture selected PostgreSQL database activities, including
data access, modifications, role changes, and DDL operations, and send audit
logs to Azure Monitor Log Analytics through diagnostic settings for centralized
querying and analysis.
This capability helps organizations improve visibility into database activity
and support security, governance, and compliance scenarios.Learn
more.
response.title: Generally Available: Azure HorizonDB Auditing
